subject: CPPTRAJ: sign convention for dihedral angles!!

messages.author: Cenk Andac
messages.body:
Hi,
I have determined ALPHA (see below for the command line) dihedral angles
through a trajectory of an RNA simulation.
dihedral G2-alpha :1.O3' :2.P :2.O5' :2.C5' out g2-alpha.dat type alpha
the alpha dihedral angles are supposed to be around g- conformer but stat
output file says the dihedral angles are around g+ as follows
STATISTICS G2-alpha
AVERAGE: 65.8043 (10.0676 stddev)
INITIAL: 64.6928
FINAL: 57.9292
g+ a+ t a- g- c
-------------------------------------------------------
%occupied | 99.1 | 0.8 | | | | 0.0 |
I am wondering if this is a bug or a different sign convention that I need
to know.
Best,
Cenk

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
On Fri, Aug 19, 2022 at 3:32 AM Cenk Andac via AMBER <amber.ambermd.org> wrote:
>
> STATISTICS G2-alpha
> AVERAGE: 65.8043 (10.0676 stddev)
> INITIAL: 64.6928
> FINAL: 57.9292
A torsion value of 65 deg. is almost right in the middle of what by
convention is considered gauche+ (between 30 and 90 degrees), so
everything seems correct. Why do you think this is a bug?
-Dan
